fato_historico: 1475: Hundred Years' War: The Treaty of Picquigny formally ends the war between the kingdoms of France and England.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to declare a truce with any lingering inner conflicts today. Much like historical rivals choosing diplomacy over struggle, you may find peace by softening your stance. It is a good time to negotiate with your own heart, choosing harmony and radiant connection instead of standing your ground. Your natural warmth will bridge any gaps today.
frase_do_dia: True strength is found in the peace we build within ourselves.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of finding stability in change.
conselho: Consider letting go of a past grievance to invite fresh luck into your life.
